body:
Friends – I’ll be leading a free online “watch party” discussion of my friend Valarie Kaur’s new TED Talk tonight (Tuesday) night at 6:30 pm ET. You can watch the video here: https://www.ted.com/…/valarie_kaur_3_lessons_of_revolutiona…
Please watch before joining the call … we’ll talk about your responses to Valarie’s message and what it means for us in these challenging times. You can join the call here: Topic:  # RevLove  Watch Party Time: Feb 13, 2018 6:30 PM Eastern Time (US and Canada) Join from PC, Mac, Linux, iOS or Android:  https://zoom.us/j/645646634 Or iPhone one-tap : US: +16468769923,,645646634# or +16699006833,,645646634# Or Telephone: Dial(for higher quality, dial a number based on your current location): US: +1 646 876 9923 or +1 669 900 6833 or +1 408 638 0968 Meeting ID: 645 646 634 International numbers available:  https://zoom.us/zoomconference…
